name: C++ 7 — Practice Lab (Structures, Unions and Scope)
description: Guided learner workspace for the seventh lab of a beginner C++ course (3×45 min) on structures, unions and scope. First block — fundamentals: defining your own struct and making an independent copy (G07_01), a structure passed by value, returned and reached through a pointer (G07_02), a tagged union (G07_03), inner blocks, name hiding and the loop variable (G07_04). Second block — project: the valid-measurement analyser (P07_meresek.cpp) built up in six steps, P1–P6 (printing one measurement with its nested date, printing the whole series, counting the valid records, averaging the valid values, counting strictly above a threshold, modifying the original record through a pointer). Third block — summary test: 10 multiple-choice questions (T1) and 10 code-comprehension tasks (T2) with output prediction and debugging. Before every part the tutor shows a short analogous sample from the MINTAKODOK collection; the learner writes, saves, compiles and runs the code (RUN button or g++ -std=c++20), and progress is tracked in HALADAS.json. No homework; for fast progress a single X1 extension may be assigned.
